projects.name: FixAsset API
projects.description: Backend API for a Fixed Asset Management System, handling assets, inventory, master data, and approval workflows.
highlights: Developed core modules for Asset, Inventory, and Approval management.
Integrated Azure AD for secure authentication and JWT for authorization.
Implemented scheduled tasks for automated notifications and workflows.
Integrated AWS S3 for robust document and image storage.
Created functionality for Excel report generation and QR code creation.
